body.purpose: All UI text; Be Vietnam Pro handles Vietnamese diacritics.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one orange action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif);min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px);background:var(--action-primary,#bf400c);color:var(--action-on-primary,#fff);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),box-shadow .15s}.ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--action-primary-hover,#9a3412);box-shadow:0 8px 18px color-mix(in srgb,#bf400c 28%,transparent)}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--grab-green,#047857);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outline action next to a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif);min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;border:1px solid var(--border,#d9cebd);border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px);background:transparent;color:var(--text-heading,#221a14);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{background:var(--pastel-peach,#fde9dc);color:var(--grab-green-hover,#065f46)}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--grab-green,#047857);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Pill field on the input surface with a green focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input{font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif);width:280px;padding:12px 20px;border:1px solid var(--border,#d9cebd);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface-input,#f9f4ec);color:var(--text-primary,#2f251d);font-size:16px}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--text-secondary,#5a4a3d)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:var(--grab-green,#047857);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,#047857 25%,transparent)}

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill filter; selected uses brand-soft fill plus a check icon.
components.css: .ds-chips{display:flex;gap:8px}.ds-chip{font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:36px;padding:6px 14px;border:1px solid var(--control-border,#9a8670);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface,#fffdf8);color:var(--text-primary,#2f251d);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer}.ds-chip:hover{background:var(--surface-muted,#f5eee3)}.ds-chip.is-on{background:var(--maps-blue-soft,#ecfdf5);border-color:var(--grab-green,#047857);color:var(--grab-green-hover,#065f46)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--grab-green,#047857);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Listing Card
components.description: Room card: photo, price first, area, distance to school.
components.html: 2,5 triệu/thángPhòng 20 m² · Linh Trung, Thủ Đức800 m tới trường
components.css: .ds-listing{font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif);width:280px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--border,#d9cebd);border-radius:var(--radius-lg,16px);background:var(--surface-elevated,#fffffc);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(34 26 20/.06),0 2px 6px -2px rgb(34 26 20/.06);transition:box-shadow .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),transform .28s}.ds-listing:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 2px 4px -1px rgb(34 26 20/.06),0 10px 20px -6px rgb(34 26 20/.1)}.ds-listing__photo{height:150px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#efe6d7,#d9cebd)}.ds-listing__body{display:grid;gap:4px;padding:12px 16px 16px;color:var(--text-primary,#2f251d);font-size:14px}.ds-listing__body strong{font-size:16px;color:var(--text-heading,#221a14)}.ds-listing__meta{color:var(--text-secondary,#5a4a3d);font-size:13px}

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status pill, rare by design.

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Signed-in header: logo, sections, active underline.
components.html: HomejiTìm phòngỞ ghépChợTin nhắn
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family: var(--font-ui, 'Be Vietnam Pro', system-ui, sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:8px 16px;background:var(--surface,#fffdf8);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#d9cebd)}.ds-nav__logo{margin-right:16px;color:var(--grab-green,#047857);font-size:20px}.ds-nav a{min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:0 12px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm,8px);color:var(--text-primary,#2f251d);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--surface-muted,#f5eee3)}.ds-nav a.is-active{color:var(--grab-green,#047857);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--grab-green,#047857)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--grab-green,#047857);outline-offset:2px}

narrative.northStar: Bản đồ xóm trọ đáng tin
narrative.overview: The signed-in app is an Operate surface: a map-first shell where students find rooms, roommates and small services near their school. It should feel like a neighbour who knows the area: warm paper, plain Vietnamese copy, precise detail. Light mode first; phones get their own UI.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream ground, walnut ink, emerald brand, burnt-orange primary action.
One primary action per view, in orange; green means brand, links, focus, active nav and success.
Map canvas stays neutral beige; category colours keep their meanings.
Tokens are global in :root with dark overrides.

rules.name: The One Orange Rule
rules.body: One primary orange action per view.

rules.name: The Neutral Map Rule
rules.body: Never paint the map canvas or large areas in brand green.

rules.name: The No Nesting Rule
rules.body: No rounded card inside another card.

dos: Use the existing tokens and the --fs-* / --radius-* scales.
Keep 44px touch targets, AA contrast and reduced-motion support.
Check light mode first, then dark, at 375px and 1280px.
donts: Don't add !important to win a specificity fight.
Don't use Unicode glyphs as icons.
Don't put two orange actions in one view.
Don't touch src/features/landing-hx from app work.
